text.tspan: ❯ Search the web for the opening hours of the British Museum, in one sentence.
⏺ web_search({"query":"British Museum opening hours"}) ✓ 2.4 s
⎿ {"content":"The British Museum is open daily from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, …
According to the [British Museum](https://www.britishmuseum.org/visit), the museum is open daily
from 10:00 to 17:00, with extended hours until 20:30 on Fridays (last entry 16:45, and 20:15 on
Fridays).
❯ Set a reminder for tomorrow at 9:00 to visit the British Museum.
⏸ Round 3 needs approval:
• reminders.create — Remind: Visit the British Museum [high risk]

that lasts beyond this chat (a routine, a reminder, a rule, a file).
